skill_tests.title: DSA Fundamentals - Arrays & Strings
skill_tests.description: Test your understanding of fundamental array and string operations, including traversal, manipulation, and common algorithmic patterns.
skill_tests.instructions: Answer all questions within the allotted time. Each question carries equal marks unless stated otherwise. You may use any programming language for coding questions.

skill_tests.title: DSA Intermediate - Trees & Graphs
skill_tests.description: Assess your knowledge of tree and graph data structures, including traversals, shortest path algorithms, and tree balancing concepts.
skill_tests.instructions: Attempt all questions. Partial credit is available for coding questions that pass some test cases. Show your approach clearly.
